Example

From a few notes to a posting.

A made-up example, showing part of the responsibilities.

What you enter

Job title: Landscaping Crew Member
Requirements: “mowing, trimming, mulching, valid driver's license, early starts, lift 50 lbs”

What you get
Responsibilities
  • Mow, trim and edge residential and commercial properties to a clean, consistent finish
  • Spread mulch and keep beds neat throughout the season
  • Load and transport equipment between job sites

Example only, shortened. Real results depend on what you enter.

FAQ

Common questions.

Where can I post it?
Anywhere you like — copy the text into any job board or your own website. The tool writes the description; it doesn't post it for you.
Can it help with interviews too?
Yes — the Hiring Manager tool writes interview questions and a full hiring kit.
Is what I enter stored?
No. What you enter is used to write your result and isn't kept afterward. The only things Workblox Business saves are your business profile and, if you use it, your Contacts list. See the Privacy Policy.
What does it cost?
Job Description Writer is part of Workblox Business. You pick your tools and pay by how many: $25/mo for 1–3 tools, $40/mo for 4–7 tools, or $75/mo for 8–16 tools, with a 7-day free trial.
